scores.evidence: Proposal targets s04 (Choose Chat Mode) where users view rates ('Premium 30 credits per message · Longer, smarter replies'), offering a timed trial right at the moment of evaluating mode differences.
Adds a timed pass via a Game Partner mini-game without taking away existing free credits or interrupting streaming responses (removesFreeValue: false).
Restricts eligibility to non-paying guest users on Basic mode, time-boxes the trial to 15 minutes, and caps it at 2 per day.
Code flags that the cost to serve the reward ($0.0090) exceeds net revenue per view ($0.0063) at the low end when using text-premium.
Triggered on s04 (Choose Chat Mode), which is a model settings sheet with relatively infrequent reach compared to the main chat loop.
Maps cleanly to SIM-RWD unit, entry=button, standard SSV (REWARD_VERIFIED), and adds a trial button to s04.
Uses screen s04, element e10 ('Premium 30 credits per message · Longer, smarter replies'), and character/game partner 'Starship Galley'.
Caps at 2 per day with a 30-minute cooldown, preventing user fatigue.
Specifies primary KPIs, guardrails (-3% non-inferiority, retention, message volume), and a user-level 10% holdout for 28 days.

requiredChanges: Switch the reward model tier from premium text to a cheaper model or reduce token count to ensure COGS stays below net revenue per view.
Consider expanding the trigger surface to include moment-of-need triggers (such as hitting zero credits in chat) to improve reach.
